game_concept: A action puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Dry Well, a nearly dry well: the sand ranger must handle sand wyrms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Refactor Rescue: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dry Well: a nearly dry well
core_gameplay_loop: In Dry Well, repeat each round: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior. Each round, a new sand maps challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the clean_score value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 70 points of sand maps by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 70, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 1 (intro tier): Refactor Rescue
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Refactor Rescue' (Week 9 slot 8), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Dry Well'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sand wyrms in Dry Well.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 70 within 42 seconds.
